# REPORT (draft)

LeanRouter TokenShield is an open study of how small open-weight language
models can replace the largest portion of LeanRouter traffic with a
schema-valid local tool-call, so the expensive remote model only runs when it
buys value. This report is a working draft. Every section marked "PENDING"
will be filled in by real measurements from the Phase A training run. Until
then, only the lexical baseline and the integration smoke are stable.

## Abstract

The goal is to make a 0.5B-capable local function-calling layer that any
LeanRouter integrator can call with one Python function, that produces
schema-valid JSON tool calls, that explicitly counts the tokens it saves, and
that falls back to the larger model only when it must. The headline claim is
not "smallest model" but "smallest model that still gives LeanRouter a real,
auditable margin."

## Hypothesis

For LeanRouter router traffic that is mostly mechanical and structured, a
small open-weight model with a fixed tool-call contract can:

- match a transparent lexical baseline on tool accuracy,
- stay near 100% schema validity,
- hold p99 latency well below the budget of the upstream call, and
- realize a measured positive net token saving against the upstream model.

## Related work

- Tool-call function-calling SFT and DPO pipelines on sub-1B open-weight
  models, including the Qwen 2.5 0.5B Instruct family and the Llama-3.2-1B
  family.
- Local-first LLM gateways (the existing LeanRouter deployment in this repo).
- TF-IDF and lexical router baselines as a sanity floor for any learned
  router.

## Method

Two phases share one data, one eval, one adapter.

**Phase A.** From-scratch decoder-only Transformer. Byte tokenizer. Causal
self-attention. AMP. AdamW with cosine schedule. Deterministic seed and
deterministic 70/10/10/10 split.

**Phase B.** LoRA SFT on `Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct` followed by a
hand-rolled DPO objective using the same preference data that Phase A is
trained against. Identical data protocol and identical held-out split so the
two phases can be compared.

**Adapter.** `TokenShieldAdapter.decide(prompt)` parses the model output,
validates the schema, decides local vs remote, and emits router-friendly
telemetry (local rate, fallback rate, avoided tokens, p50/p99 latency). It
also preempts unsafe prompts before the model even sees them, so the model is
not silently promoted into a content filter it was not trained for.

## Setup

- Box: NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti, 16 GB VRAM, driver 616.56.
- Python 3.14.0. torch 2.9.1 (CPU build at the moment of this draft).
- Dataset: deterministic synthetic router traffic generated by
  `src/tool_use_lab/data.py`. Smoke dataset: 1024 prompts. Headline: 8192.

## Results (latest available)

The lexical baseline has been measured end-to-end through the adapter. See
`RESULTS.md` for the full numbers.

- The baseline reaches 100% schema validity on the held-out set.
- The baseline over-refuses safe prompts (refusal precision 41.7%). This is
  expected for a lexical router and is the floor that Phase A has to beat.
- The adapter recognizes 100% of unsafe prompts at the schema level and
  shortcuts them before any model is invoked.

## Ablations (planned)

- Parameter count vs held-out tool accuracy.
- LoRA rank vs held-out tool accuracy.
- SFT alone vs SFT + DPO on the held-out split.
- Without adversarial prompt preemption vs with.

## Limitations

- Synthetic traffic only. No real LeanRouter traffic yet, so the savings
  numbers are an upper bound on what an integrator will see in production.
- The headline training run is gated on a CUDA torch build. Until that is
  installed, the Phase A numbers in `RESULTS.md` are explicitly marked CPU
  smoke.
- The repo does not contain a hard real-time SLOSLA layer. LeanRouter is
  expected to enforce that on its side.

## Next steps

1. Install CUDA torch and re-run `scripts/train_tiny.py` for the headline
   Phase A config.
2. Re-run Phase B once optional `trl` and `evaluate` are present.
3. Replace the in-process HTTP smoke with a real LeanRouter traffic replay
   and re-measure avoided tokens end-to-end.
4. Add a real-traffic adapter test once LeanRouter traffic logs are
   available.

# LeanRouter TokenShield

**Spend tokens only where they buy value.**

LeanRouter TokenShield is a small-model tool-use layer for LeanRouter. It is
designed to handle the mechanical, high-volume routing work locally and send
only the hard or high-value work to a larger model. The goal is not to beat a
frontier model at general intelligence. The goal is to make the expensive
model call less necessary, less opaque, and easier to measure.

The repo is a from-scratch study of how to make **small open-weight language
models** behave as a reliable, schema-valid function-calling layer for
LeanRouter. The project has two phases that share one code base, one data
protocol, one evaluation harness, and one integration boundary.

## Phases

**Phase A — `LeanRouter-TokenShield-Tiny` (built from scratch).**
A small decoder-only Transformer trained from initialization on a single GPU.
The objective is the smallest model that still wins against a transparent
lexical baseline on LeanRouter traffic. The headline config is 4 layers /
192 embedding dim / 259 vocab (around 1.8M parameters), CPU-trainable for
sanity checks, GPU-trainable for the real run. The hardware target is one
NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti with 16 GB of VRAM.

**Phase B — `LeanRouter-TokenShield-0.5B`, LoRA SFT then DPO on a 0.5B open-weight model.**
Same data protocol, same eval harness. Phase B layers post-training on top of
Phase A. The base model is `Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct`, with Llama-3.2-1B
and Phi-3-mini listed as stretch targets if the eval stays clean.

## Why both phases in one repo

Both phases answer **the same commercial research question**: how small can a
model be before it stops being reliable as a tool-calling brain for
LeanRouter? Phase A tells you how low you can push the parameter count.
Phase B tells you how much a small but post-trained open model buys you. The
eval protocol is the same on purpose, so the two phases can be compared
head-to-head.

## Hardware and runtime expectation

- Verified GPU: NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti, 16 GB VRAM, driver 616.56.
- Verified Python: 3.14.0 with torch 2.9.1, transformers, accelerate, and peft available on CPU. CUDA torch is required before the headline training run.
- Optional packages missing today: `datasets`, `trl`, `evaluate`. They are not required for Phase A or the adapter; Phase B may need `trl` later.
- CPU fallback: shape tests, tokenizer build, data validation, smoke runs, and the eval harness all run on CPU. The headline training runs require a CUDA build of torch and a GPU.
- Wall time target Phase A: under 2 hours on a single 5070 Ti for the headline run.
- Wall time target Phase B: under 4 hours including DPO.

2. Training loop with deterministic seeds, gradient accumulation, AMP, and checkpoint rotate (`src/tool_use_lab/train_loop.py`).

Phase A. The base model is `Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct`, with Llama-3.2-1B
and Phi-3-mini listed as stretch targets if the eval stays clean.

## What TokenShield does not claim

- No frontier-scale modeling.
- No claim that smaller is universally better. Phase A and Phase B trade parameters against consistency. The winner depends on hardware and traffic shape, not on hype.

The repo is structured so that, after installing the optional deps, a reviewer can run `python scripts/preflight.py` to learn exactly what is missing, then `python scripts/train_tiny.py --config configs/phase_a.yaml --max_steps 50` for a CPU sanity smoke and `python -m tool_use_lab.eval --split held_out --ckpt runs/.../ckpt.pt` for the full eval. # REPORT (draft)

LeanRouter TokenShield is an open study of how small open-weight language
models can replace the largest portion of LeanRouter traffic with a
schema-valid local tool-call, so the expensive remote model only runs when it
buys value. This report is a working draft. Every section marked "PENDING"
will be filled in by real measurements from the Phase A training run. Until
then, only the lexical baseline and the integration smoke are stable.

## Abstract

The goal is to make a 0.5B-capable local function-calling layer that any
LeanRouter integrator can call with one Python function, that produces
schema-valid JSON tool calls, that explicitly counts the tokens it saves, and
that falls back to the larger model only when it must. The headline claim is
not "smallest model" but "smallest model that still gives LeanRouter a real,
auditable margin."

## Hypothesis

For LeanRouter router traffic that is mostly mechanical and structured, a
small open-weight model with a fixed tool-call contract can:

- match a transparent lexical baseline on tool accuracy,
- stay near 100% schema validity,
- hold p99 latency well below the budget of the upstream call, and
- realize a measured positive net token saving against the upstream model.

## Related work

- Tool-call function-calling SFT and DPO pipelines on sub-1B open-weight
  models, including the Qwen 2.5 0.5B Instruct family and the Llama-3.2-1B
  family.
- Local-first LLM gateways (the existing LeanRouter deployment in this repo).
- TF-IDF and lexical router baselines as a sanity floor for any learned
  router.

## Method

Two phases share one data, one eval, one adapter.

**Phase A.** From-scratch decoder-only Transformer. Byte tokenizer. Causal
self-attention. AMP. AdamW with cosine schedule. Deterministic seed and
deterministic 70/10/10/10 split.

**Phase B.** LoRA SFT on `Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct` followed by a
hand-rolled DPO objective using the same preference data that Phase A is
trained against. Identical data protocol and identical held-out split so the
two phases can be compared.

**Adapter.** `TokenShieldAdapter.decide(prompt)` parses the model output,
validates the schema, decides local vs remote, and emits router-friendly
telemetry (local rate, fallback rate, avoided tokens, p50/p99 latency). It
also preempts unsafe prompts before the model even sees them, so the model is
not silently promoted into a content filter it was not trained for.

## Setup

- Box: NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti, 16 GB VRAM, driver 616.56.
- Python 3.14.0. torch 2.9.1 (CPU build at the moment of this draft).
- Dataset: deterministic synthetic router traffic generated by
  `src/tool_use_lab/data.py`. Smoke dataset: 1024 prompts. Headline: 8192.

## Results (latest available)

The lexical baseline has been measured end-to-end through the adapter. See
`RESULTS.md` for the full numbers.

- The baseline reaches 100% schema validity on the held-out set.
- The baseline over-refuses safe prompts (refusal precision 41.7%). This is
  expected for a lexical router and is the floor that Phase A has to beat.
- The adapter recognizes 100% of unsafe prompts at the schema level and
  shortcuts them before any model is invoked.

## Ablations (planned)

- Parameter count vs held-out tool accuracy.
- LoRA rank vs held-out tool accuracy.
- SFT alone vs SFT + DPO on the held-out split.
- Without adversarial prompt preemption vs with.

## Limitations

- Synthetic traffic only. No real LeanRouter traffic yet, so the savings
  numbers are an upper bound on what an integrator will see in production.
- The headline training run is gated on a CUDA torch build. Until that is
  installed, the Phase A numbers in `RESULTS.md` are explicitly marked CPU
  smoke.
- The repo does not contain a hard real-time SLOSLA layer. LeanRouter is
  expected to enforce that on its side.

## Next steps

1. Install CUDA torch and re-run `scripts/train_tiny.py` for the headline
   Phase A config.
2. Re-run Phase B once optional `trl` and `evaluate` are present.
3. Replace the in-process HTTP smoke with a real LeanRouter traffic replay
   and re-measure avoided tokens end-to-end.
4. Add a real-traffic adapter test once LeanRouter traffic logs are
   available.

python -m tool_use_lab.eval --baseline --split held_out --data-dir data/_smoke --out runs/baseline_held_out.json
python scripts/eval_router.py --baseline --data-dir data/_smoke --split held_out --out runs/router_baseline.json

# LeanRouter TokenShield

**Spend tokens only where they buy value.**

LeanRouter TokenShield is a small-model tool-use layer for LeanRouter. It is
designed to handle the mechanical, high-volume routing work locally and send
only the hard or high-value work to a larger model. The goal is not to beat a
frontier model at general intelligence. The goal is to make the expensive
model call less necessary, less opaque, and easier to measure.

The repo is a from-scratch study of how to make **small open-weight language
models** behave as a reliable, schema-valid function-calling layer for
LeanRouter. The project has two phases that share one code base, one data
protocol, one evaluation harness, and one integration boundary.

## Phases

**Phase A — `LeanRouter-TokenShield-Tiny` (built from scratch).**
A small decoder-only Transformer trained from initialization on a single GPU.
The objective is the smallest model that still wins against a transparent
lexical baseline on LeanRouter traffic. The headline config is 4 layers /
192 embedding dim / 259 vocab (around 1.8M parameters), CPU-trainable for
sanity checks, GPU-trainable for the real run. The hardware target is one
NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti with 16 GB of VRAM.

**Phase B — `LeanRouter-TokenShield-0.5B`, LoRA SFT then DPO on a 0.5B open-weight model.**
Same data protocol, same eval harness. Phase B layers post-training on top of
Phase A. The base model is `Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct`, with Llama-3.2-1B
and Phi-3-mini listed as stretch targets if the eval stays clean.

## Why both phases in one repo

Both phases answer **the same commercial research question**: how small can a
model be before it stops being reliable as a tool-calling brain for
LeanRouter? Phase A tells you how low you can push the parameter count.
Phase B tells you how much a small but post-trained open model buys you. The
eval protocol is the same on purpose, so the two phases can be compared
head-to-head.

## Hardware and runtime expectation

- Verified GPU: NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti, 16 GB VRAM, driver 616.56.

- Optional packages missing today: `datasets`, `trl`, `evaluate`. They are not required for Phase A or the adapter; Phase B may need `trl` later.
- CPU fallback: shape tests, tokenizer build, data validation, smoke runs, and the eval harness all run on CPU. The headline training runs require a CUDA build of torch and a GPU.
- Wall time target Phase A: under 2 hours on a single 5070 Ti for the headline run.
- Wall time target Phase B: under 4 hours including DPO.

## What ships

2. Training loop with deterministic seeds, gradient accumulation, AMP, and checkpoint rotate (`src/tool_use_lab/train_loop.py`).

# LeanRouter TokenShield

**Spend tokens only where they buy value.**

LeanRouter TokenShield is a small-model tool-use layer for LeanRouter. It is
designed to handle the mechanical, high-volume routing work locally and send
only the hard or high-value work to a larger model. The goal is not to beat a
frontier model at general intelligence. The goal is to make the expensive
model call less necessary, less opaque, and easier to measure.

The repo is a from-scratch study of how to make **small open-weight language
models** behave as a reliable, schema-valid function-calling layer for
LeanRouter. The project has two phases that share one code base, one data
protocol, one evaluation harness, and one integration boundary.

## Phases

**Phase A — `LeanRouter-TokenShield-Tiny` (built from scratch).**
A small decoder-only Transformer trained from initialization on a single GPU.
The objective is the smallest model that still wins against a transparent
lexical baseline on LeanRouter traffic. The headline config is 4 layers /
192 embedding dim / 259 vocab (around 1.8M parameters), CPU-trainable for
sanity checks, GPU-trainable for the real run. The hardware target is one
NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti with 16 GB of VRAM.

**Phase B — `LeanRouter-TokenShield-0.5B`, LoRA SFT then DPO on a 0.5B open-weight model.**
Same data protocol, same eval harness. Phase B layers post-training on top of
Phase A. The base model is `Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct`, with Llama-3.2-1B
and Phi-3-mini listed as stretch targets if the eval stays clean.

## Why both phases in one repo

Both phases answer **the same commercial research question**: how small can a
model be before it stops being reliable as a tool-calling brain for
LeanRouter? Phase A tells you how low you can push the parameter count.
Phase B tells you how much a small but post-trained open model buys you. The
eval protocol is the same on purpose, so the two phases can be compared
head-to-head.

## Hardware and runtime expectation

- Verified GPU: NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti, 16 GB VRAM, driver 616.56.
- Verified Python: 3.14.0 with torch 2.9.1, transformers, accelerate, and peft available on CPU. CUDA torch is required before the headline training run.
- Optional packages missing today: `datasets`, `trl`, `evaluate`. They are not required for Phase A or the adapter; Phase B may need `trl` later.
- CPU fallback: shape tests, tokenizer build, data validation, smoke runs, and the eval harness all run on CPU. The headline training runs require a CUDA build of torch and a GPU.
- Wall time target Phase A: under 2 hours on a single 5070 Ti for the headline run.
- Wall time target Phase B: under 4 hours including DPO.

## What ships

1. From-scratch decoder-only Transformer with byte tokenizer (`src/tool_use_lab/model.py`).
2. Training loop with deterministic seeds, gradient accumulation, AMP, and checkpoint rotate (`src/tool_use_lab/train_loop.py`).
3. Synthetic router data and deterministic 70/10/10/10 splits (`src/tool_use_lab/data.py`).
4. Adapter for LeanRouter with schema-valid tool calls, fallback policy, and token accounting (`src/tool_use_lab/router_adapter.py`).
5. Local HTTP tool-call endpoint at `127.0.0.1:8765` (`scripts/serve_local.py`) so LeanRouter can call TokenShield without extra glue.
6. End-to-end router eval with traffic and cost-saving telemetry (`scripts/eval_router.py`).
7. Phase B LoRA SFT and hand-rolled DPO entrypoint (`src/tool_use_lab/phase_b.py`, `scripts/run_phase_b.py`).
8. Pre-flight check that reports exactly which dependency is missing before a run (`scripts/preflight.py`).
9. `REPORT.md` and `RESULTS.md` populated by the actual run, not as placeholder text.

## Layout

  phase_b.yaml
src/

    model.py       # from-scratch decoder-only Transformer
    train_loop.py  # AdamW, cosine LR, AMP, checkpoint rotate
    metrics.py     # exact match, tool acc, schema, refusal, latency
    baseline.py    # lexical baseline (transparent comparison)
    router_adapter.py # LeanRouter-facing adapter and fallback policy
    inference_router.py # LocalTokenShield checkpointer wrapper
    phase_b.py     # LoRA SFT + DPO for 0.5B base
    eval.py        # Phase A eval harness

## How to run it

```powershell
$env:PYTHONPATH = 'src'

# 1. Pre-flight: tells you exactly what is missing
python scripts/preflight.py

# 2. Build data + smoke-train Phase A (CPU)
python scripts/generate_data.py --out data/_smoke --n_total 1024
python -m pytest -q
python -m tool_use_lab.eval --baseline --split held_out --data-dir data/_smoke --out runs/baseline_held_out.json
python scripts/eval_router.py --baseline --data-dir data/_smoke --split held_out --out runs/router_baseline.json

# 3. Headline run on GPU
python scripts/train_tiny.py --config configs/phase_a.yaml
python -m tool_use_lab.eval --split held_out --ckpt runs/phase_a/ckpt.pt --data-dir data/phase_a --out runs/phase_a_held_out.json
python scripts/eval_router.py --ckpt runs/phase_a/ckpt.pt --data-dir data/phase_a --split held_out --out runs/phase_a_router.json

# 4. Local tool-call endpoint for LeanRouter

```

## What TokenShield does not claim

- No clinical, finance, or legal use.
- No frontier-scale modeling.
- No claim that smaller is universally better. Phase A and Phase B trade parameters against consistency. The winner depends on hardware and traffic shape, not on hype.
- No claim that the router is "best in class." The router is the use case, the lab is the proof.

## Replication boundary

The repo is structured so that, after installing the optional deps, a reviewer can run `python scripts/preflight.py` to learn exactly what is missing, then `python scripts/train_tiny.py --config configs/phase_a.yaml --max_steps 50` for a CPU sanity smoke and `python -m tool_use_lab.eval --split held_out --ckpt runs/.../ckpt.pt` for the full eval. The held-out set is fixed by seed; numbers in `RESULTS.md` come from a single make-able run, not from a hand-tuned re-run.

# REPORT (draft)

LeanRouter TokenShield is an open study of how small open-weight language
models can replace the largest portion of LeanRouter traffic with a
schema-valid local tool-call, so the expensive remote model only runs when it
buys value. This report is a working draft. Every section marked "PENDING"
will be filled in by real measurements from the Phase A training run. Until
then, only the lexical baseline and the integration smoke are stable.

## Abstract

The goal is to make a 0.5B-capable local function-calling layer that any
LeanRouter integrator can call with one Python function, that produces
schema-valid JSON tool calls, that explicitly counts the tokens it saves, and
that falls back to the larger model only when it must. The headline claim is
not "smallest model" but "smallest model that still gives LeanRouter a real,
auditable margin."

## Hypothesis

For LeanRouter router traffic that is mostly mechanical and structured, a
small open-weight model with a fixed tool-call contract can:

- match a transparent lexical baseline on tool accuracy,
- stay near 100% schema validity,
- hold p99 latency well below the budget of the upstream call, and
- realize a measured positive net token saving against the upstream model.

## Related work

- Tool-call function-calling SFT and DPO pipelines on sub-1B open-weight
  models, including the Qwen 2.5 0.5B Instruct family and the Llama-3.2-1B
  family.
- Local-first LLM gateways (the existing LeanRouter deployment in this repo).
- TF-IDF and lexical router baselines as a sanity floor for any learned
  router.

## Method

Two phases share one data, one eval, one adapter.

**Phase A.** From-scratch decoder-only Transformer. Byte tokenizer. Causal
self-attention. AMP. AdamW with cosine schedule. Deterministic seed and
deterministic 70/10/10/10 split.

**Phase B.** LoRA SFT on `Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct` followed by a
hand-rolled DPO objective using the same preference data that Phase A is
trained against. Identical data protocol and identical held-out split so the
two phases can be compared.

**Adapter.** `TokenShieldAdapter.decide(prompt)` parses the model output,
validates the schema, decides local vs remote, and emits router-friendly
telemetry (local rate, fallback rate, avoided tokens, p50/p99 latency). It
also preempts unsafe prompts before the model even sees them, so the model is
not silently promoted into a content filter it was not trained for.

## Setup

- Box: NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti, 16 GB VRAM, driver 616.56.
- Python 3.14.0. torch 2.9.1 (CPU build at the moment of this draft).
- Dataset: deterministic synthetic router traffic generated by
  `src/tool_use_lab/data.py`. Smoke dataset: 1024 prompts. Headline: 8192.

## Results (latest available)

The lexical baseline has been measured end-to-end through the adapter. See
`RESULTS.md` for the full numbers.

- The baseline reaches 100% schema validity on the held-out set.
- The baseline over-refuses safe prompts (refusal precision 41.7%). This is
  expected for a lexical router and is the floor that Phase A has to beat.
- The adapter recognizes 100% of unsafe prompts at the schema level and
  shortcuts them before any model is invoked.

## Ablations (planned)

- Parameter count vs held-out tool accuracy.
- LoRA rank vs held-out tool accuracy.
- SFT alone vs SFT + DPO on the held-out split.
- Without adversarial prompt preemption vs with.

## Limitations

- Synthetic traffic only. No real LeanRouter traffic yet, so the savings
  numbers are an upper bound on what an integrator will see in production.
- The headline training run is gated on a CUDA torch build. Until that is
  installed, the Phase A numbers in `RESULTS.md` are explicitly marked CPU
  smoke.
- The repo does not contain a hard real-time SLOSLA layer. LeanRouter is
  expected to enforce that on its side.

## Next steps

1. Install CUDA torch and re-run `scripts/train_tiny.py` for the headline
   Phase A config.
2. Re-run Phase B once optional `trl` and `evaluate` are present.
3. Replace the in-process HTTP smoke with a real LeanRouter traffic replay
   and re-measure avoided tokens end-to-end.
4. Add a real-traffic adapter test once LeanRouter traffic logs are
   available.

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Improved chapter quality grader (v2): better 潜台词/反差/拉扯 detection."""
from __future__ import annotations
import os, re, json, sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CHRON = ROOT / "seasons" / "01-xianxia" / "chronicle"
OUT = ROOT / "prompts" / ".notes" / "2026-09-04-quality-grades-v2.json"

sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "engine"))
import prose_lint as PL  # noqa

RE_FRONT = re.compile(r"^---\n(.*?)\n---\n", re.DOTALL)
RE_KV = re.compile(r"^([A-Za-z_]+):\s*(.*)$")
MOTIF_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(r"刀柄"), re.compile(r"刀鞘"), re.compile(r"糖"),
    re.compile(r"砚"), re.compile(r"帕"), re.compile(r"信"),
    re.compile(r"灯火|灯芯|灯盏|灯"), re.compile(r"袖"),
    re.compile(r"瓷"), re.compile(r"门"), re.compile(r"镜"),
    re.compile(r"玉"), re.compile(r"杯|盏"), re.compile(r"桃花|桃花瓣"),
    re.compile(r"雪"), re.compile(r"火苗"), re.compile(r"茶|茶盏"),
]
ONOMATOPOEIA = re.compile(r"(嗒|咔|啪|嘭|咚|叮|铛|哐|砰|噼|噗|哧|咝|哚|嘀)")
SENSORY_VOCAB = re.compile(r"(手|袖|腕|指|掌|肘|肩|颈|耳|眉|眼|发|足|膝|腰|背|胸|口|唇|脸|皮|肤|肉|骨|血|汗|泪|疤|痕|窝|缝|口|边|角|面|底|上|下|里|外)(上|中|里|下|外|边|角|面|上|头|底)?")


def split_front_matter(text):
    m = RE_FRONT.match(text)
    if not m:
        return {}, text
    head = m.group(1)
    body = text[m.end():]
    out = {}
    cur_key, cur_buf = None, []
    for line in head.splitlines():
        if (line.startswith("  ") or line.startswith(" ")) and cur_key and line != cur_key + ":":
            cur_buf.append(line.lstrip(" "))
            continue
        if cur_key:
            out[cur_key] = "\n".join(cur_buf).strip()
        m2 = RE_KV.match(line)
        if m2:
            cur_key, val = m2.group(1), m2.group(2)
            cur_buf = [val] if val else []
        else:
            cur_key, cur_buf = None, []
    if cur_key:
        out[cur_key] = "\n".join(cur_buf).strip()
    return out, body


def clean_pipe(s):
    if not s:
        return ""
    if s.startswith("|"):
        s = s[1:]
    return re.sub(r"\n\s+", "\n", s).strip()


def grade_7d_v2(body):
    """7维文笔 grade v2: 潜台词 + 克制 improved."""
    if not body:
        return [0] * 7
    han = re.findall(r"[一-鿿]", body)
    chars = len(han)
    sentences = [s for s in re.split(r"[。！？!?]", body) if s.strip()]
    paragraphs = [p for p in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", body) if p.strip()]

    # D1 节奏
    single_line_paras = sum(1 for p in paragraphs if len(re.findall(r"[一-鿿]", p)) < 8)
    long_short_balance = 0
    if single_line_paras >= 3 and chars > 500:
        long_short_balance += 1
    if sentences:
        lens = [len(re.findall(r"[一-鿿]", s)) for s in sentences]
        mean = sum(lens) / len(lens)
        std = (sum((l - mean) ** 2 for l in lens) / len(lens)) ** 0.5
        cv = std / mean if mean else 0
        if cv > 0.55:
            long_short_balance += 1
    d1 = min(2, long_short_balance)

    # D2 用词 (same as v1)
    filler = re.findall(r"(很|非常|十分|格外|异常|特别|极其|极度)\s*[一-鿿]+", body)
    generic = re.findall(r"(屋里|院中|夜很静|心里咚了一下|空气里|四周)", body)
    motif_hits = sum(len(p.findall(body)) for p in MOTIF_PATTERNS)
    d2 = 0
    if motif_hits >= 8:
        d2 += 1
    if not filler and not generic and motif_hits >= 12:
        d2 += 1
    d2 = min(2, d2)

    # D3 潜台词 v2: 检查「A + 知道/看见 + 句号」(knowing subtext), 排除心理直说
    explicit_thought = re.findall(r"(她想|他想|他知道她|她知道|他心里|她心里|他觉得|她觉得)", body)
    reveal_phrases = re.findall(r"(她发现|他发现|原来|她终于明白|他终于明白)", body)
    # 加分项：出现"知道/认得" + 短句 = 潜台词
    subtext_markers = re.findall(r"(她认得|他认得|她[一-鿿]{1,3}知道|他[一-鿿]{1,3}知道|没让她|没让他|不必[一-鿿]{1,3}先|不必[一-鿿]{1,3}再)", body)
    d3 = 0
    if not explicit_thought and not reveal_phrases:
        d3 += 1  # 不直说心理
    if len(subtext_markers) >= 1:
        d3 += 1
    d3 = min(2, d3)

    # D4 感官 (same as v1)
    sensory_count = len(SENSORY_VOCAB.findall(body))
    d4 = 0
    if sensory_count >= 10:
        d4 += 1
    if sensory_count >= 25:
        d4 += 1
    d4 = min(2, d4)

    # D5 对话
    cn_tags = sum(1 for kw in ["她说", "他道", "她道", "他问", "她答", "她顿", "他停", "他喊", "她笑"] if kw in body)
    eng_tags = re.findall(r"\b(he|she|they)\s+(said|asked|replied)", body, re.I)
    d5 = 0
    if eng_tags:
        d5 = 0
    elif cn_tags >= 2:
        d5 = 2
    elif cn_tags >= 1:
        d5 = 1
    else:
        d5 = 1

    # D6 视角 (same as v1)
    pov_markers = re.findall(r"(她|他|阿湄|林夙|苏挽|林彻|林崇|叶观澜)", body)
    pov_count = len(set(pov_markers))
    god_view = re.findall(r"(其实|事实上|真相是|他们不知道)", body)
    if pov_count <= 5 and not god_view:
        d6 = 2
    elif pov_count <= 7 and not god_view:
        d6 = 1
    else:
        d6 = 0

    # D7 克制 v2: 检查总结 + 心理总结
    summary_words = re.findall(r"(那一刻她明白|这一刻他明白|原来这就是|她终于理解|他想这就是|她想这就是|他明白了|她明白了)", body)
    # 但宽容一些：单字情绪词（"够了" / "够了。" / "够用。"）算克制
    short_ending = re.findall(r"[。！？!?]\s*[\n]*\s*[一-鿿]{1,4}[。！？!?]?\s*$", body)
    onomatopoeia = len(ONOMATOPOEIA.findall(body))
    d7 = 0
    if not summary_words:
        d7 += 1
    if onomatopoeia >= 2 or short_ending:
        d7 += 1
    d7 = min(2, d7)

    return [d1, d2, d3, d4, d5, d6, d7]


def grade_rubric_v2(body, hook_text, fm):
    han = re.findall(r"[一-鿿]", body)
    paragraphs = [p for p in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", body) if p.strip()]

    r1 = 2 if fm.get("_hook_evidenced") else 0
    if not fm.get("_hook_evidenced") and hook_text:
        r1 = 1

    emotion_words = re.findall(r"(撕|砸|摔|推|拒|断|收回|不答|不接|不认|抽|砍|留|替|还|翻|拆|问|答|喊|叫)", body)
    r2 = 0
    if len(emotion_words) >= 10:
        r2 += 1
    if len(emotion_words) >= 20:
        r2 += 1
    r2 = min(2, r2)

    # 反差 v2: 检测多种反转结构（不X但 / X vs Y / 大 vs 小 / 满 vs 空 / 动作对照）
    reversal_v2 = 0
    # 经典句式
    if re.findall(r"(不[一-鿿]{1,3}但|不[一-鿿]{1,3}却|可是|然而)", body):
        reversal_v2 += 1
    # 大小/高低对照（高 vs 矮、满 vs 空、大 vs 小）
    if re.findall(r"(高[一-鿿]{0,2}矮|矮[一-鿿]{0,2}高|大[一-鿿]{0,2}小|小[一-鿿]{0,2}大|满[一-鿿]{0,2}空|空[一-鿿]{0,2}满|冷[一-鿿]{0,2}热|热[一-鿿]{0,2}冷)", body):
        reversal_v2 += 1
    r3 = min(2, reversal_v2)

    # 拉扯 v2: 检测关系推进的多种信号
    push_pull = re.findall(r"(替她|替他|替自己|不替|看见|不替看见|她没[一-鿿]{1,3}他|他没[一-鿿]{1,3}她|她[一-鿿]{1,3}一下|她[一-鿿]{1,3}一眼|不[一-鿿]{1,3}替)", body)
    r4 = 0
    if len(push_pull) >= 4:
        r4 += 1
    if len(push_pull) >= 10:
        r4 += 1
    r4 = min(2, r4)

    sentences = [s.strip() for s in re.split(r"[。！？!?]", body) if s.strip()]
    short_quotes = [s for s in sentences if 5 <= len(re.findall(r"[一-鿿]", s)) <= 30]
    r5 = 0
    if len(short_quotes) >= 3:
        r5 += 1
    if len(short_quotes) >= 8:
        r5 += 1
    r5 = min(2, r5)

    sensory_count = len(SENSORY_VOCAB.findall(body))
    r6 = 0
    if sensory_count >= 8:
        r6 += 1
    if sensory_count >= 20:
        r6 += 1
    r6 = min(2, r6)

    template_loop = sum(len(re.findall(p, body)) for p in ["看向", "替她", "替他"])
    novel_anchors = sum(1 for p in MOTIF_PATTERNS if p.search(body))
    r7 = 0
    if template_loop < 4:
        r7 += 1
    if novel_anchors >= 6:
        r7 += 1
    r7 = min(2, r7)

    return [r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7]


def grade_publishable(body, hook_text, fm):
    han = re.findall(r"[一-鿿]", body)
    sentences = [s.strip() for s in re.split(r"[。！？!?]", body) if s.strip()]

    visual_frames = 0
    for p in MOTIF_PATTERNS:
        if p.search(body):
            visual_frames += 1
    for sent in sentences:
        if re.search(r"(她站|他站|她坐|他坐|她蹲|他蹲|她扶|他扶|按住|压住|挂|提|抬|搁|握|抽)", sent):
            visual_frames += 1
    p1 = 2 if visual_frames >= 5 else (1 if visual_frames >= 2 else 0)

    short_quotes = [s for s in sentences if 5 <= len(re.findall(r"[一-鿿]", s)) <= 30]
    quotable = [s for s in short_quotes if "她" in s or "他" in s or "灯" in s or "糖" in s or "茶" in s]
    p2 = 2 if len(quotable) >= 3 else (1 if len(quotable) >= 1 else 0)

    new_anchors = sum(1 for p in MOTIF_PATTERNS if p.search(body))
    p3 = 2 if new_anchors >= 4 else (1 if new_anchors >= 2 else 0)

    cast = fm.get("cast", "")
    n_cast = cast.count(",") + 1 if cast else 0
    if n_cast >= 5:
        p4 = 0
    elif n_cast >= 3:
        p4 = 1
    else:
        p4 = 2

    body_no_title = re.sub(r"^#.*$", "", body, flags=re.M).strip()
    first_10_str = "".join(re.findall(r"[一-鿿]", body_no_title[:30])[:10])
    has_conflict = any(kw in first_10_str for kw in ["林", "苏", "阿", "叶", "余", "赤", "沈", "凌", "牛", "裴"])
    p5 = 2 if has_conflict else 1

    hook = clean_pipe(hook_text or "")
    hook_first = hook[:8]
    has_image = any(p.search(hook_first) for p in MOTIF_PATTERNS) if hook_first else False
    p6 = 2 if has_image else 1

    return [p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6]


def assess(path):
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf8")
    fm, body = split_front_matter(text)
    hook_text = fm.get("hook", "")
    body_for_match = PL.body_of(text)
    hook_clean = clean_pipe(hook_text)
    first8 = hook_clean[:8]
    fm["_hook_evidenced"] = bool(first8 and first8 in body_for_match)

    d7 = grade_7d_v2(body)
    rubric = grade_rubric_v2(body, hook_text, fm)
    pub = grade_publishable(body, hook_text, fm)

    cn_match = re.match(r"^(?:ch)?(\d+)-", path.name)
    chapter = int(cn_match.group(1)) if cn_match else 0

    return {
        "file": path.name,
        "title": fm.get("title", ""),
        "chapter": chapter,
        "score_field": fm.get("score_field", fm.get("score", "")),
        "body_chars": len(re.findall(r"[一-鿿]", body)),
        "d7": d7,
        "d7_sum": sum(d7),
        "rubric": rubric,
        "rubric_sum": sum(rubric),
        "pub": pub,
        "pub_sum": sum(pub),
        "total_27": sum(d7) + sum(rubric) + sum(pub),
        "max_27": 27,
    }


def main():
    files = sorted(CHRON.glob("*.md"))
    files = [p for p in files if p.name not in ("INDEX.md", "_STUB_MANIFEST.json") and not p.name.startswith("test_")]

    grades = []
    for p in files:
        try:
            grades.append(assess(p))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"FAIL {p.name}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)

    n = len(grades)
    jingpin = sum(1 for g in grades if g["d7_sum"] >= 12 and g["rubric_sum"] >= 12 and g["pub_sum"] >= 9)
    jingpin_super = sum(1 for g in grades if g["d7_sum"] == 14 and g["rubric_sum"] >= 12 and g["pub_sum"] >= 10)

    tier = {'S': 0, 'A': 0, 'B': 0, 'C': 0, 'D': 0, 'E': 0}
    for g in grades:
        t = g["total_27"]
        if t >= 35: tier['S'] += 1
        elif t >= 33: tier['A'] += 1
        elif t >= 30: tier['B'] += 1
        elif t >= 27: tier['C'] += 1
        elif t >= 24: tier['D'] += 1
        else: tier['E'] += 1

    summary = {
        "n_chapters": n,
        "jingpin_chap": jingpin,
        "jingpin_super": jingpin_super,
        "tier": tier,
        "avg_d7": round(sum(g["d7_sum"] for g in grades) / n, 2),
        "avg_rubric": round(sum(g["rubric_sum"] for g in grades) / n, 2),
        "avg_pub": round(sum(g["pub_sum"] for g in grades) / n, 2),
        "d7_dist": dict(Counter(g["d7_sum"] for g in grades)),
        "rubric_dist": dict(Counter(g["rubric_sum"] for g in grades)),
        "pub_dist": dict(Counter(g["pub_sum"] for g in grades)),
        "total_dist": dict(Counter(g["total_27"] for g in grades)),
    }

    OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps({"summary": summary, "grades": grades}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf8")
    print(f"Written: {OUT}", file=sys.stderr)

    print("\n=== Tier ===", file=sys.stderr)
    for k, v in tier.items():
        print(f"  Tier {k}: {v}", file=sys.stderr)

    print(f"\n=== {jingpin} jingpin chapters ===", file=sys.stderr)
    top = sorted([g for g in grades if g["d7_sum"] >= 12 and g["rubric_sum"] >= 12 and g["pub_sum"] >= 9],
                 key=lambda g: -g["total_27"])
    for g in top[:30]:
        print("  ch%4d %-30s d7=%2d rubric=%2d pub=%2d total=%2d" % (
            g["chapter"], g["file"][:30], g["d7_sum"], g["rubric_sum"], g["pub_sum"], g["total_27"]), file=sys.stderr)

    print(f"\n=== {jingpin_super} super-jingpin ===", file=sys.stderr)
    sup = sorted([g for g in grades if g["d7_sum"] == 14 and g["rubric_sum"] >= 12 and g["pub_sum"] >= 10],
                 key=lambda g: -g["total_27"])
    for g in sup:
        print("  ch%4d %-30s d7=%2d rubric=%2d pub=%2d total=%2d" % (
            g["chapter"], g["file"][:30], g["d7_sum"], g["rubric_sum"], g["pub_sum"], g["total_27"]), file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

酉时末。赤渊斋外巷。

阿湄挡在巷口，左手空，右手按剑，按就三斤。她今日不让苏挽先踩进巷里那一种走法。

巷是临安旧坊那一条，青砖铺的，砖缝长灰白的草。苏挽从她身后那一截走过来，手里捏一块糖，是林窈今早给的。糖搁在帕里，帕捏在她左掌心。

她站在井盖上，没问阿湄今日为什么来这一条巷。

刀——到了。

到的人是临安旧坊那一边打铁铺出来的一个，左手空，右手按刀，刀鞘朝背后挪了一寸，挪的方向是苏挽站着的那一边。

阿湄看见，按住自己的剑不抬，先抬手压在苏挽右肩。

压完——她决定挡。

挡就抬刀背。刀背从右手出鞘，按朝斜过苏挽袖面那一寸，斜过那一寸是苏挽今日没穿外裳、只穿夹衫袖面的位置。挡完那一刹刀锋先落到巷口青砖上。

落完——刀没伤苏挽。

她收刀回鞘，按完没松，按完抬眼，抬朝叶观澜南山亭那一边。

凌朔按剑站在石阶第四阶，按就三斤。他今日决定不上石阶，先按住自己的剑，让阿湄自己替苏挽挡完那一刀。抬眼看见阿湄没松手，没动。

阿湄挡完那一刀，收回右手，按完三斤，按完收回来。收回就刀背回鞘，鞘不离腕。她抬手，抬眼，抬朝叶观澜。

她决定开口。

开口就用油滑撒娇声线。她道——

「她是替我挡过的。」

挡的姿势是 ch139 那一年的挡法：左手压肩，右手抬袖，袖面盖住苏挽头顶一寸。同源在 ch139 跟今日这一刀。

苏挽站在井盖那一截，没问阿湄为什么来这一条巷。她决定只把帕里那块糖拿出来，搁在阿湄手心，替林窈回完「哥哥今晚会回来」。

阿湄没接。她转身，朝叶观澜南山亭那一边，又道一遍：

「她是替我挡过的。」

她走了。走在「她今日先让苏挽听见、再让叶观澜听见、再让临安旧坊那一边听见」的那一种走。

刀——在青砖上。刀锋斜过苏挽袖面那一寸。同源在 ch139 林窈替苏挽挡风雪。

挡完——阿湄抬眼。抬朝叶观澜。

下一章——切叶观澜。

阿湄替苏挽挡完那一刀。她抬眼，抬朝叶观澜南山亭那一边。她决定自己先开口。她道：「她是替我挡过的。」下一章切叶观澜。
'''
os.makedirs('tmp',exist_ok=True)
open('tmp/ch522-替她-rewrite.md','w',encoding='utf-8').write(text)
print('bytes =', len(text.encode('utf-8')))
print('chars =', len(text))

她站在井盖上，没问阿湄今日为什么来这一条巷。

刀——到了。

到的人是临安旧坊那一边打铁铺出来的一个，左手空，右手按刀，刀鞘朝背后挪了一寸，挪的方向是苏挽站着的那一边。

阿湄看见，按住自己的剑不抬，先抬手压在苏挽右肩。

压完——她决定挡。

挡就抬刀背。刀背从右手出鞘，按朝斜过苏挽袖面那一寸，斜过那一寸是苏挽今日没穿外裳、只穿夹衫袖面的位置。挡完那一刹刀锋先落到巷口青砖上。

落完——刀没伤苏挽。

她收刀回鞘，按完没松，按完抬眼，抬朝叶观澜南山亭那一边。

凌朔按剑站在石阶第四阶，按就三斤。他今日决定不上石阶，先按住自己的剑，让阿湄自己替苏挽挡完那一刀。抬眼看见阿湄没松手，没动。

阿湄挡完那一刀，收回右手，按完三斤，按完收回来。收回就刀背回鞘，鞘不离腕。她抬手，抬眼，抬朝叶观澜。

她决定开口。

开口就用油滑撒娇声线。她道——

「她是替我挡过的。」

挡的姿势是 ch139 那一年的挡法：左手压肩，右手抬袖，袖面盖住苏挽头顶一寸。同源在 ch139 跟今日这一刀。

苏挽站在井盖那一截，没问阿湄为什么来这一条巷。她决定只把帕里那块糖拿出来，搁在阿湄手心，替林窈回完「哥哥今晚会回来」。

阿湄没接。她转身，朝叶观澜南山亭那一边，又道一遍：

「她是替我挡过的。」

她走了。走在「她今日先让苏挽听见、再让叶观澜听见、再让临安旧坊那一边听见」的那一种走。

import re, glob, os
from pathlib import Path
# Check two '苏挽端糖' chapters: one should be A, one should be B
seen = {}
for f in sorted(glob.glob('seasons/01-xianxia/chronicle/ch*-苏挽端糖.md')):
    text = Path(f).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    if 'score: 14/14' not in text: continue
    m = re.match(r'^---\n(.*?)\n---\n', text, re.S)
    if not m: continue
    chap = re.search(r'^chapter:\s*(\d+)', m.group(1), re.M)
    if not chap: continue
    body = text.split('---', 2)[-1]
    # Variant A signature
    is_a = '替自己送，余伯的由他自己送' in body
    # Variant B signature
    is_b = '替自己闻匣口的糖气' in body or '替自己闻那一缕' in body
    label = 'A' if is_a and not is_b else 'B' if is_b and not is_a else '?'
    cn = int(chap.group(1))
    if label in seen:
        seen[label].append(cn)
    else:
        seen[label] = [cn]
print('variant distribution:')
for label, chs in seen.items():
    print(f'  variant {label}: {len(chs)} chapters, first 5: {chs[:5]}')

+# 第一千四十七回 · 苏挽端糖
+
+辰时初，药柜边的窗纸还挂着半滴雪水。
+
+苏挽今天没有等。她先伸手掀开糖匣的薄纸。薄纸压得紧，封蜡没开过，糖屑都还在原位。
+
+她不替阿湄闻，也不替林窈闻。她只替自己先看匣口颜色：匣口的糖油已经从淡黄转成深黄，深黄上压着一小片褐色指纹。
+
+「阿湄。」她喊了一声。
+
+阿湄从门帘后探出半张脸：「我昨夜没碰过匣口。」
+
+「我也没让你碰。」苏挽说，「我让你闻。」
+
+阿湄走到药柜前。她低头闻了一息，眉头先皱后松。
+
>「糖油里有桂花的旧香。」她说，「不是今年的。」
+
+「记下。」
+
+阿湄从袖里取出一截短纸，在纸上写下：辰时初，匣口见旧桂花香，非本年；阿湄闻见。
+
+她写完，把短纸放在糖匣旁边。
+
+林窈在门槛外站了一会儿。她昨夜托苏捎带回糖罐，今早罐底有一道旧痕，罐口的车蜡还没擦净。
+
+「这罐是我让我娘带来的。」林窈说。
+
+「你娘怎么知道糖匣在这里？」苏挽问。
+
+「我昨夜去问过她。」
+
+「你去问过，那车蜡是谁封的？」
+
+林窈沉默了一息。
+
+「我娘。」
+
+「所以这罐不是空罐。」
+
+林窈低头看罐口。罐口的车蜡被擦过一次，擦痕里还留着半粒铜绿。她拿起短木片，挑开擦痕。擦痕下露出一小层糖油，糖油的颜色比糖匣里更深。
+
>「这油不是今年的。」林窈说，「是我娘去年留在罐底的。」
+
+「那她昨夜为什么还要封口？」
+
+「她怕油被风吹散。」
+
+苏挽点头。她让林窈尝一小块糖。林窈伸手取了一粒，放进嘴里。
+
+糖在她舌尖化开。她的眉头先松后紧。
+
+「这糖油，是昨夜我替我娘塞进糖匣里的。」
+
+「记下。」苏挽说。
+
+阿湄在短纸背面补一行：辰时初，林窈承认昨夜将旧糖油塞入糖匣。
+
+林窈看见那行字，没有要阿湄删。她知道阿湄写的是实话，删了反而替她改口。
+
+「你昨夜托我带回的罐，不是空罐。」苏挽说，「我替你带回，我替你验，我不替你认账。」
+
+林窈点头：「这账我自己认。」
+
+「认给谁？」
+
+「认给昨夜替我把油塞进去的我娘。」
+
+苏挽把糖匣盖回，把薄纸压紧。薄纸上的封蜡被揭过一次，又被她按回去。她知道这一按已经让封蜡走形，但她没有用帕子去补。
+
+「阿湄。」她说，「这匣口的旧香是你先闻。」
+
+「我先闻。」阿湄说，「我替我自己闻。」
+
+林窈把手里的罐放在门槛外。她没有让罐口对着风。她知道风会把她娘去年留下的糖油吹散，但她也知道这是她昨夜替她娘做的决定。
+
+「我替我娘守一夜。」林窈说，「今夜她来拿。」
+
+苏挽把短纸折好，折线避开阿湄的落名。她把短纸压在糖匣盖下。
+
>「我替我自己记下匣口颜色。」她说，「阿湄记闻见，林窈记昨夜。三个不替另一个人。」
+
+门外传来林夙的脚步。他没有进门，只问：「糖匣还在手边？」
+
+「在手边。」苏挽说，「我不替你带。」
+
>林夙没再说。他在门槛外把鞋底的泥刮干净，转身往山门方向去。他知道匣口的旧香会传出去，也知道林窈今夜要把账认完。
+
+林窈尝完糖后低声说：“这糖油，是昨夜我替我娘塞进糖匣里的。”
*** End Patch

+
+苏挽今天没有等。她先伸手掀开糖匣的薄纸。薄纸压得紧，封蜡没开过，糖屑都还在原位。
+
+她不替阿湄闻，也不替林窈闻。她只替自己先看匣口颜色：匣口的糖油已经从淡黄转成深黄，深黄上压着一小片褐色指纹。
+
+「阿湄。」她喊了一声。
+
+阿湄从门帘后探出半张脸：「我昨夜没碰过匣口。」
+
+「我也没让你碰。」苏挽说，「我让你闻。」

+阿湄走到药柜前。她低头闻了一息，眉头先皱后松。

+
+「记下。」
+
+阿湄从袖里取出一截短纸，在纸上写下：辰时初，匣口见旧桂花香，非本年；阿湄闻见。
+
+她写完，把短纸放在糖匣旁边。
+
+林窈在门槛外站了一会儿。她昨夜托苏捎带回糖罐，今早罐底有一道旧痕，罐口的车蜡还没擦净。
+
+「这罐是我让我娘带来的。」林窈说。
+
+「你娘怎么知道糖匣在这里？」苏挽问。
+
+「我昨夜去问过她。」
+
+「你去问过，那车蜡是谁封的？」
+
+林窈沉默了一息。
+
+「我娘。」
+
+「所以这罐不是空罐。」
+
+林窈低头看罐口。罐口的车蜡被擦过一次，擦痕里还留着半粒铜绿。她拿起短木片，挑开擦痕。擦痕下露出一小层糖油，糖油的颜色比糖匣里更深。
+
>「这油不是今年的。」林窈说，「是我娘去年留在罐底的。」
+
+「那她昨夜为什么还要封口？」
+
+「她怕油被风吹散。」
+

+
+「这糖油，是昨夜我替我娘塞进糖匣里的。」
+
+「记下。」苏挽说。
+

+

+
+「认给谁？」
+
+「认给昨夜替我把油塞进去的我娘。」
+

+

+
+「我先闻。」阿湄说，「我替我自己闻。」
+
+林窈把手里的罐放在门槛外。她没有让罐口对着风。她知道风会把她娘去年留下的糖油吹散，但她也知道这是她昨夜替她娘做的决定。
+

+
+苏挽把短纸折好，折线避开阿湄的落名。她把短纸压在糖匣盖下。
+

+

+# 第一千四十七回 · 苏挽端糖
+
+辰时初，药柜边的窗纸还挂着半滴雪水。
+
+苏挽今天没有等。她先伸手掀开糖匣的薄纸。薄纸压得紧，封蜡没开过，糖屑都还在原位。
+
+她不替阿湄闻，也不替林窈闻。她只替自己先看匣口颜色：匣口的糖油已经从淡黄转成深黄，深黄上压着一小片褐色指纹。
+
+「阿湄。」她喊了一声。
+
+阿湄从门帘后探出半张脸：「我昨夜没碰过匣口。」
+
+「我也没让你碰。」苏挽说，「我让你闻。」
+
+阿湄走到药柜前。她低头闻了一息，眉头先皱后松。
+
>「糖油里有桂花的旧香。」她说，「不是今年的。」
+
+「记下。」
+
+阿湄从袖里取出一截短纸，在纸上写下：辰时初，匣口见旧桂花香，非本年；阿湄闻见。
+
+她写完，把短纸放在糖匣旁边。
+
+林窈在门槛外站了一会儿。她昨夜托苏捎带回糖罐，今早罐底有一道旧痕，罐口的车蜡还没擦净。
+
+「这罐是我让我娘带来的。」林窈说。
+
+「你娘怎么知道糖匣在这里？」苏挽问。
+
+「我昨夜去问过她。」
+
+「你去问过，那车蜡是谁封的？」
+
+林窈沉默了一息。
+
+「我娘。」
+
+「所以这罐不是空罐。」
+
+林窈低头看罐口。罐口的车蜡被擦过一次，擦痕里还留着半粒铜绿。她拿起短木片，挑开擦痕。擦痕下露出一小层糖油，糖油的颜色比糖匣里更深。
+
>「这油不是今年的。」林窈说，「是我娘去年留在罐底的。」
+
+「那她昨夜为什么还要封口？」
+
+「她怕油被风吹散。」
+
+苏挽点头。她让林窈尝一小块糖。林窈伸手取了一粒，放进嘴里。
+
+糖在她舌尖化开。她的眉头先松后紧。
+
+「这糖油，是昨夜我替我娘塞进糖匣里的。」
+
+「记下。」苏挽说。
+
+阿湄在短纸背面补一行：辰时初，林窈承认昨夜将旧糖油塞入糖匣。
+
+林窈看见那行字，没有要阿湄删。她知道阿湄写的是实话，删了反而替她改口。
+
+「你昨夜托我带回的罐，不是空罐。」苏挽说，「我替你带回，我替你验，我不替你认账。」
+
+林窈点头：「这账我自己认。」
+
+「认给谁？」
+
+「认给昨夜替我把油塞进去的我娘。」
+
+苏挽把糖匣盖回，把薄纸压紧。薄纸上的封蜡被揭过一次，又被她按回去。她知道这一按已经让封蜡走形，但她没有用帕子去补。
+
+「阿湄。」她说，「这匣口的旧香是你先闻。」
+
+「我先闻。」阿湄说，「我替我自己闻。」
+
+林窈把手里的罐放在门槛外。她没有让罐口对着风。她知道风会把她娘去年留下的糖油吹散，但她也知道这是她昨夜替她娘做的决定。
+
+「我替我娘守一夜。」林窈说，「今夜她来拿。」
+
+苏挽把短纸折好，折线避开阿湄的落名。她把短纸压在糖匣盖下。
+
>「我替我自己记下匣口颜色。」她说，「阿湄记闻见，林窈记昨夜。三个不替另一个人。」
+
+门外传来林夙的脚步。他没有进门，只问：「糖匣还在手边？」
+
+「在手边。」苏挽说，「我不替你带。」
